remarks: This one bedroom, corner unit offers abundant natural light and privacy. The kitchen is ideal for those who enjoy cooking or entertaining. The modern design and high-end finishes ensure that this space is both functional and stylish. Enjoy tranquility with the new double-pane sliders, and head out from your spacious bedroom or living room to relax on the balcony - ideal for your morning coffee or evening wind-down. The building is equipped with fiber wiring, providing high-speed internet - great for remote workers. Location is key, and this unit is about a three-minute drive to downtown Stamford, a five-minute drive to I-95, and to the nearest beach. Explore a vibrant array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options all within easy reach. Additionally, the HOA, covers heat, water, hot water sewer and an assigned parking space adding extra convenience and value to your living experience! Whether you're an investor or a homeowner, this is a fantastic opportunity. Pet friendly too!
